canonical_project: BDIC / UniCloud Africa Makurdi Tier III Data Centre
owner: Benue Digital Infrastructure Company, UniCloud Africa, Africa Data Centres and partners
notes: MoU calls for a state-owned data center and cloud ecosystem in Makurdi, with Africa Data Centres providing a disaster recovery site in Abuja. DCD reported estimated project cost of NGN 10.8 billion and six-month completion target; no MW capacity disclosed.
